title: fix(ui): retire stalled pull-request subscription acknowledgments
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: pull-request subscriptions and explicit refreshes can remain stuck when an acknowledgment is lost on an otherwise healthy chat connection.

## User Impact

Lost subscription acknowledgments recover through the existing retry policy without reconnecting chat. Superseded declarations release their local pending request; one-shot readers settle when their operation deadline expires.

## Why This Change Was Made

Use the established 30-second request deadline and a per-declaration AbortSignal at the existing subscription owner. Preserve coalesced refresh intent, same-set admission, visibility behavior, and the final empty declaration followed by immediate detach. Late responses cannot confirm newer state.

Production LOC: +19/-4 (net +15) | Tests: +535/-147 (net +388). The added declaration state retires obsolete local waits without a second timeout owner. One production owner changes. This does not change global RPC deadlines, socket reconnect policy, server refresh quotas, or the viewer-presence owner. Aborting a local waiter does not claim cancellation of work already admitted by the server.

## Evidence

- Original owner: eight intended deadline/abort regression failures with 44 existing cases passing.
- Original Chromium route: after 60 virtual seconds, only one subscription declaration was sent instead of the expected retry.
- Fixed owner, real pending-request boundary, shared retry and affected caller suites: 114 tests passed after the capability-loss repair.
- Routed recovery and the existing refresh-replay sibling passed. The first new fixture selected an initial empty declaration; exact target-set selection and held-ack response routing were corrected, and only the failed browser case was repeated. Seven other source hashes were unchanged.
- Fresh review found that temporary capability omission could discard an in-flight forced refresh. A real pending-request regression reproduced the missing refresh keys; the owner now retains still-watched intent before retirement. The new regression also proves stale acknowledgments cannot settle the restored request and no retry runs while the capability is absent.
- All 14 initial selected local static stages passed. The repaired source passed the fresh browser case and all eight applicable static recovery phases. Fresh full eight-file automated review completed both passes with no actionable findings. Exact-head hosted/native gates remain required.

The browser proof uses the actual Control UI with a synthetic Gateway that withholds an acknowledgment while continuing normal ticks. No external-Gateway, deployment, or physical OS claim. No rendered appearance changes.

### Current Readiness

The shared sidebar request assertion is corrected in `09a3399ef3a2564252cc3cbf6c763cc70cf0a1c9`: one added expectation for the established 30-second deadline and AbortSignal, with no production changes. Source-only AutoReview found no actionable issues.

Configured Linux Testbox proof ran the complete `app-sidebar.sessions.test.ts` file with one worker: **147 passed, 0 skipped**, 14.343s child wall / 12.96s Vitest duration. Node 24.19.0 and pnpm 12.4.0 were verified. The native receiver verified the complete candidate tree `9b36950f25a1da5fe4bb1b2cbe4fa87f1e178e0c`, identical to the published commit tree.

The explicit corrected-path dry-run and actual changed checks selected `ui/src/test-helpers/app-sidebar-cases/session-indicators.ts` (coreTests and UI lanes). All 20 stages passed, including all 25 core-test typecheck shards; the final targeted formatter, diff check, and unchanged test-postimage assertion also passed. Native command exit was 0 (27m14.403s); lease cleanup was independently confirmed completed. [Testbox allocation workflow](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36151893503). Its Actions status is not the delegated command verdict and may reflect lease cleanup.

The original source checkout and the clean proof checkout are retained. No application tests or checks ran on the operator host. Prior lifecycle/browser evidence above is retained, not replayed. [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36155531665) attempt 1 completed successfully on `09a3399ef3a2564252cc3cbf6c763cc70cf0a1c9`: 73 successful jobs and 18 skipped, zero failed. [Workflow Sanity](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36155531433) also passed. Native landing qualification remains required.

### New-File Cost Measurements

The two previously unmeasured files ran sequentially on configured Linux Testbox, one worker each, against the same published source and tree `9b36950f25a1da5fe4bb1b2cbe4fa87f1e178e0c`. Node 24.19.0, pnpm 12.4.0, Vitest 5.0.0, Playwright 1.63.0, and Chromium were verified. Exact tree, index, all 203 frozen dependency inputs, physical working directory, and clean source were checked before and in a final check after both commands.

| File | Actual result | Monotonic child wall | Vitest duration |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui/src/lib/session-pull-requests.deadline.test.ts` | 9 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped | 2.395068814s | 1.32s |
| `ui/src/e2e/session-pull-requests.e2e.test.ts` | 1 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped | 13.012070977s | 11.98s |

Commands used the existing runner, without configuration or harness changes:

```sh
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui.config.ts --configLoader runner --maxWorkers=1 ui/src/lib/session-pull-requests.deadline.test.ts
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.ui-e2e.config.ts --configLoader runner --maxWorkers=1 --project ui-e2e-bundled ui/src/e2e/session-pull-requests.e2e.test.ts
```

Default and JSON reporters were enabled to verify the exact selected file and case statuses. Browser wall time includes the normal bundled Control UI build and browser setup; this is not a new visual-evidence campaign. Both commands and the final source check exited 0. The native wrapper returned exit 0 / succeeded, and the owned lease was stopped and independently confirmed completed. [Allocation workflow](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36158332803); its Actions status is not the delegated command verdict.

Available current CI job metadata gives shared `checks-ui` shard wall times of 353/349/313s (test steps 245/248/229s), and executed `checks-ui-e2e` shard wall times of 721/669/668/613/551/662/531/587s. These include other files and setup, not incremental costs of this PR. Exact file-to-shard attribution was not recovered; shard 9 skipped the Control UI E2E step and is excluded. See the [UI lane](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36155531665/job/108139624739) and [E2E lane](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36155531665/job/108139624740) metadata.

This resolves the fresh review's missing two-file cost report. The [older failed CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35832549224) and attribution of its other failed UI job remain unresolved historical evidence, not exonerated by these passes. Its guarded failure-log request was not retried. Synthetic Gateway/browser proof still makes no external-Gateway, deployment, or physical-OS claim.
